dismissed.title: Hard-coded sizes in new CSS instead of design tokens

upheld.detail: CreateItem checks with AnyAsync and then calls SaveChanges, with no DbUpdateException handling. Two concurrent creates with the same unused explicit id both pass the check, and the second fails with Postgres 23505 → 500. Also, explicit ids (seeded 1-101, or an earlier explicit create) do not move th
upheld.requirement: BUG-18: Expected: 409 Conflict, or the id is ignored and a new one is generated (Actual: 500; Postgres raises a primary key violation)

dismissed.title: Race between the existing-id check and the insert still returns 500
dismissed.reason: Duplicate of ACC-1-1 (the same check-then-insert race at CatalogApi.cs:476-498 with the same fix); the critic withdrew it. Kept under ACC-1-1.

dismissed.title: Client-set ids can later collide with database-generated ids (500)
dismissed.reason: Duplicate of ACC-1-1, which already covers the sequence collision for a create without an id and has the same remedy. The story allows the 'check and return 409' option, so ignoring client ids is not required. Withdrawn by the critic.

dismissed.title: Redundant null-conditional on non-nullable parameter
dismissed.reason: item?.Name matches the existing pattern in the neighbouring UpdateItemV1 (CatalogApi.cs:408, productToUpdate?.Id) and changes no behavior. Withdrawn by the critic.

dismissed.title: Duplicated test helpers across the two new test classes
dismissed.reason: Pure preference. Two story-scoped test classes with small local helpers break no stated repository guideline. Withdrawn by the critic.
